info.name: Pipedrive API v1 Activities DealProducts API
info.description: Activities are appointments/tasks/events on a calendar that can be associated with a deal, a lead, a person and an organization. Activities can be of different type (such as call, meeting, lunch or a custom type - see ActivityTypes object) and can be assigned to a particular user. Note that activities can also be created without a specific date/time.

item.name: Get deal products of several deals

query.description: (Required) An array of integers with the IDs of the deals for which the attached products will be returned. A maximum of 100 deal IDs can be provided.

For pagination, the marker (an opaque string value) representing the first item on the next page
For pagination, the limit of entries to be returned. If not provided, 100 items will be returned. Please note that a maximum value of 500 is allowed.
The field to sort by. Supported fields: `id`, `deal_id`, `add_time`, `update_time`, `order_nr`.
The sorting direction. Supported values: `asc`, `desc`.
